name: Sono Hanabira ni Kuchizuke o: Yuririn
original_name: その花びらにくちづけを　ゆりりん
source:
Risa, her weight in extremely (beep) condition due to all those delicious snacks and tea, has resolved to go on a diet! However… cutting sweets out of your diet is extremely hard, so seeing how much Risa is suffering, Mai recommends a cycling diet. Hearing how Mai already successfully lost five kilograms, Risa is extremely interested!

[From [url=http://petalsgarden.axypb.net/visual-novel-yuricycle/]Petals' Garden[/url]]
translation:
莉纱因为那些美味的点心和茶而严重发胖，于是决定节食！然而……戒掉甜食极其困难。麻衣看到莉纱如此痛苦，便向她推荐骑自行车减肥。听说麻衣已经成功减掉五公斤，莉纱顿时产生了浓厚兴趣！

[来源：[url=http://petalsgarden.axypb.net/visual-novel-yuricycle/]Petals’ Garden[/url]]
